summary: Session 2 testing completed for RRL Builders CRM. All 8 backend API tests passed (100%). Key features verified: 1) Public booking form with new fields (profession dropdown, document upload buttons, tower as text input, floor_rise_cost manual field, terms & conditions checkbox). 2) Delete customer functionality with confirmation dialog. CRITICAL BUG FIXED: Fixed customer ID generation race condition that caused duplicate key errors.

fixed_during_testing.issue: DuplicateKeyError (E11000) on customer creation - customer_id collision when customers were deleted and new ones created
fixed_during_testing.root_cause: generate_customer_id() used count_documents() which doesn't account for deleted records
fixed_during_testing.fix_applied: Changed to atomic counter using find_one_and_update with upsert on a 'counters' collection
fixed_during_testing.verification: All booking form submissions now work correctly
